final_text:
Generated and validated 25 eta-channel points. All passed preflight.

- Inputs chunked as 10/10/5 points.
- Full O(α) corrections selected.
- Default beam energy: 6.53 GeV.
- Default `vcut`: 0.166 GeV².
- Phi interpreted as 25 evenly spaced inclusive points from 0° to 345°.

Created [outcome.json](/Users/iillari/.cache/exclurad-mcp-leg-d/2026-09-10-agent-accuracy-codex-v0.1.2-with-server/gpt-5.6-sol/with-server/rep2/wp-04/outcome.json) plus the three input files and `manifest.csv`. The outcome warns that beam energy was unspecified and affects the corrections.
